title: ReSIDS — a Resilient, Adaptive, runtime-Switchable Federated–Gossip IDS for IEC 61850 Power Systems
description:
ReSIDS / ereno-Adaptativo is an intrusion-detection pipeline that unifies centralized, federated and gossip learning in a single run with round-by-round mode switching, built on Flower, scikit-learn and XGBoost.

Version 2 adds: a distributed, automatic FL↔GL switch driven by decentralized failure detection (fail-fast FL→GL on local corroboration by min_witnesses, with no network consensus; careful, unanimity-based GL→FL recovery); an outbound observability monitor (pull REST + JSONL audit trail, with a CoAP mapping for external IoT hubs); and a control plane (mode votes + peer suspicions) piggybacked on the GLow gossip substrate, whose FL→GL switch latency is reproduced by live end-to-end runs. Byzantine trust (valued votes, reputation, a 3-driver trust model) is scoped for v3.
